Article 5 / A Member of the United Nations against which preventive or enforcement action has been taken by the Security Council may be suspended from the exercise of the rights and privileges of mem- bership by the General Assembly upon the recom- mendation of the Security Council.

Article 6 A Member of the United Nations which has persistently violated the Principles contained in the present Charter may be expelled from the Organization by the General Assembly upon the recommendation of the Security Council.

Accordingly, our respective Governments, through representatives assembled in the city of San Francisco, who have exhibited their full powers found to be in good and due form, have agreed to the present Charter of the United Nations and do hereby establish an international organization to be known as the United Nations.

The ICRC also endeavours to prevent suffering by promoting and strengthening humanitarian law and universal humanitarian principles. Established in 1863, the ICRC is at the origin of the Geneva Conventions and the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. Burnham, the former Manchester Mayor who re-entered parliament in June by winning a by-election in the Makerfield constituency, said his party “didn’t get it right” on the war on Gaza and “needs to do better” once he is leader.

1 Lebanon: Flash Update #40 - Escalation of hostilities in Lebanon, OCHA UNFPA Situation Report I Lebanon I 23 June - 7 July 2026 Situation Overview An estimated 646,107 people in Lebanon have begun returning to their areas of origin, with population movements increasing by 23 per cent in the past two weeks.
Displacement levels continue to decline, with the proportion of displaced persons residing in collective shelters decreasing from 11 per cent to 9 per cent over the past two weeks.
As of 1 July 2026, some 499,784 internally displaced persons have been recorded across Lebanon.
related.excerpt: Situation Report Lebanon Crisis 23 June - 7 July 2026 Highlights The humanitarian situation in Lebanon remains fragile despite a reduction in hostilities, with significant and persistent humanitarian, protection, and early recovery needs. Daily airstrikes and military operations, particularly in southern Lebanon, continue to pose risks to civilians and limit safe returns, highlighting the potential for renewed escalation despite ongoing diplomatic efforts. Since 2 March 2026, a reported 4,304 people have been killed and 12,203 have been injured. Women and girls are bearing the brunt of the crisis, facing heightened protection and gender-based violence (GBV) risks, disrupted health services, including for maternal health, and reduced access to safe and dignified support. Since the onset of the crisis, UNFPA has reached over 150,000 displaced people with sexual and reproductive health (SRH) and GBV services.
